recognize_zh: 淋巴球門內的 CD3 對 CD2 流式圖：左下角為大量 CD3-/CD2- 細胞（CLL 的 B 細胞），右上角為一小群 CD3+/CD2+ 的正常 T 細胞，另有少量 CD2+/CD3- 的 NK 細胞；T 細胞沒有抗原喪失，屬背景正常 T 細胞。
features: Lymphocyte-gated dot plot of CD3-PC5.5 (x-axis) versus CD2-PC7 (y-axis)
Dominant CD3-negative/CD2-negative population in the lower left, representing B cells
Discrete CD3-positive/CD2-positive T-cell cluster with uniform bright expression
Small scattered CD2-positive/CD3-negative events consistent with NK cells
No aberrant T-cell population with loss of CD2 or CD3
describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD3 versus CD2 on gated lymphocytes shows that most lymphocytes are CD3-negative and CD2-negative, consistent with a predominant B-cell population. A discrete T-cell cluster coexpresses CD3 and CD2 with normal intensity, and a few CD2-positive, CD3-negative NK cells are present. There is no evidence of an aberrant T-cell population with pan-T antigen loss. Findings indicate relatively reduced but phenotypically normal T cells, consistent with a background to chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: T-cell lymphoma with pan-T antigen loss
ddx.vs: Neoplastic T cells show loss or dim expression of CD2, CD3, CD5, or CD7, unlike the uniformly bright CD3/CD2 T cells here.

ddx.dx: Chronic lymphoproliferative disorder of NK cells
ddx.vs: NK-cell expansions show a large CD2-positive/CD3-negative population, whereas NK cells here are sparse.
T-LGL expands a CD3-positive/CD8-positive/CD57-positive population often with dim CD5 or CD7, rather than a small normal T-cell cluster.
